text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives message from Libyan leader.
- U.S. ambassador reiterates Washington's commitment to the security of Kuwait.
- Two deals in Egyptian shares and two in Lebanese shares at the Kuwait Stock Exchange on the first cross-trading day with the bourses of Egypt and Lebanon.
- Parliamentarian wants national debate on jobs. Deputies expect an unemployement problem in the near future if the state fails to creat more jobs.
- Parliament to issue a weekly magazine.
- Kuwait seeks $116.6 billion in compensation for losses reulting from Iraq's 1990-91 occupation.
- Trade volume and share index fall on Monday.
